doc.title: Asset Management Features
doc.summary: This document outlines various features within the Digii Asset Management module, covering vendor creation, administrative privilege assignment, defining asset categories and sub-categories, managing consumable products, recording purchase details, and handling asset allotments and returns.

prerequisites.name: Admin Console Access
prerequisites.description: Users must have appropriate administrative access to the Digii Admin Console to access the Asset Management module and its features.

chunks.what_it_does: Allows users to add new vendor details within the Asset Management module, including their contact and other relevant information.
chunks.why_it_matters: Essential for tracking suppliers of assets and consumables, streamlining procurement processes, and maintaining a comprehensive vendor database.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Go to the Vendor Details tab.
Click on the "Add Vendor" button.
Enter the required vendor details.
Click on "Save".
examples: An administrator needs to add 'Office Supplies Inc.' as a new vendor after signing a new procurement contract.

Where can I find vendor details?

Can I manage suppliers in Asset Management?

chunks.feature_name: Assign Admin Privileges in Asset Management
chunks.what_it_does: Enables administrators to assign specific privileges to members for managing categories, sub-categories, products, or individual assets within the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Ensures proper access control and delegation of responsibilities, allowing different users to manage specific aspects of assets without granting full administrative access.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Admin Privileges" tab.
Click on the "Add Member" button to assign privileges to a member.
To view assigned privileges, click on the "View" hyperlink.
To modify privileges, click on the "Edit" button, make changes, and save.
examples: An administrator assigns a specific staff member the privilege to manage only 'IT Equipment' categories.
user_questions: How do I give someone access to manage assets?
Can I restrict a user to only certain asset categories?
Where can I see who has asset management privileges?
How do I change a user's asset permissions?

chunks.what_it_does: Allows administrators to define and manage the structure of assets by adding categories and sub-categories within the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Provides a structured framework for organizing and classifying all assets, which is crucial for efficient inventory management, reporting, and tracking.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Asset Schema" tab.
From here, you can add categories and sub-categories.
NOTE: Fields are not applicable for Sub-category created for Consumable Assets.
examples: Setting up 'IT Equipment' as a category and 'Laptops' or 'Printers' as sub-categories.
user_questions: How do I set up asset categories?
What is an asset schema?
Can I create sub-categories for assets?
Where do I define asset types?
How to organize my assets?

chunks.what_it_does: Enables administrators to add new asset categories one by one within the Asset Schema section of the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Provides flexibility for creating specific asset classifications as needed, ensuring that all types of assets can be properly categorized and tracked.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Asset Schema" tab.
In the Category section, click on the "+Add" button.
Select "Add Single" to add a category individually.
examples: Adding 'Furniture' or 'Lab Equipment' as a new asset category.
user_questions: How do I add one asset category?
Can I create a new asset category manually?
What are the steps to add a single asset category?
Where do I define a new asset type?

chunks.what_it_does: Allows Asset Administrators to efficiently add multiple asset categories simultaneously by uploading a Comma Separated Values (CSV) file.
chunks.why_it_matters: Significantly speeds up the process of populating the asset management system with a large number of categories, reducing manual entry and potential errors.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Asset Schema" tab.
In the Category section, click on the "+Add" button.
Select "Add Bulk" to upload multiple categories.
Prepare a CSV file with mandatory fields: Name, Auto Generate ID, Category ID (if Auto Generate Id is false), and Type.
Upload the CSV file.
examples: An administrator uploads a CSV file containing 50 new categories for different types of office supplies and equipment.

How to add multiple categories using a CSV?

chunks.what_it_does: Enables administrators to add new asset sub-categories one by one within the Asset Schema section of the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Provides granular classification for assets, allowing for more detailed organization and tracking within broader categories.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Asset Schema" tab.
In the Sub-Category section, click on the "+Add" button.
Select "Add Single" to add a sub-category individually.
Note: Consumable category does not support custom fields.
examples: Adding 'Laser Printers' as a sub-category under the 'IT Equipment' category.

Can I create a new asset sub-category manually?

chunks.what_it_does: Allows Asset Administrators to efficiently add multiple asset sub-categories simultaneously by uploading a Comma Separated Values (CSV) file.
chunks.why_it_matters: Streamlines the process of populating the asset management system with detailed sub-classifications, improving data entry efficiency and accuracy for large inventories.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Click on the "Asset Schema" tab.
In the Sub-Category section, click on the "+Add" button.
Select "Add Bulk" to upload multiple sub-categories.
Prepare a CSV file with mandatory fields: Category Name, Category ID, Sub-Category Name, Auto Generate ID, and Sub-Category ID (if Auto Generate Id is false).
Upload the CSV file.
examples: An administrator imports a CSV file to add all sub-categories for 'Office Furniture' like 'Chairs', 'Desks', and 'Cabinets'.

chunks.feature_name: Add Products for Consumable Assets Individually
chunks.what_it_does: Allows administrators to create and add individual product entries specifically for consumable assets within the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Enables precise tracking and management of individual consumable items, facilitating inventory control and ensuring availability of necessary supplies.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
In the "Manage Products" tab, click on the "Create Product" button to add individual product.
examples: Adding 'Printer Ink Cartridge Model XYZ' as a new consumable product.
user_questions: How do I add a single consumable product?
Where can I create new consumable items?
What is the process to add a product for consumable assets?
Can I add one consumable product at a time?

chunks.feature_name: Bulk Upload Products for Consumable Assets
chunks.what_it_does: Enables Asset Administrators to efficiently upload a large number of consumable products using an Excel sheet (or CSV file), streamlining inventory setup.
chunks.why_it_matters: Significantly reduces the time and effort required to onboard new consumable product lines or update existing ones in bulk, improving data accuracy and operational efficiency.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
In the "Manage Products" tab, click on the "Bulk Upload" button to add products in bulk.
Prepare an Excel sheet (or CSV) with mandatory fields: Product Name, Product Code, Company Name, Sub-Category Name, Sub-Category Code, and Unit Name.
Upload the file.
examples: An administrator uploads an Excel sheet containing 200 new stationery items to be tracked as consumable assets.

chunks.feature_name: Add New Purchase Details for Consumable Assets
chunks.what_it_does: Allows Asset Administrators to record new purchase orders and their details for consumable assets within the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Essential for maintaining accurate records of inventory acquisition, managing budgets, and tracking the cost and source of consumable supplies.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
In the "Purchase Details" tab, click on the "New Purchase" button to add new purchase details.
Enter the purchase order details.
Save the purchase details.
examples: Recording a new purchase order for 100 reams of paper from 'Office Supplies Inc.'.

Where can I add purchase order details?

chunks.feature_name: View Existing Purchase Details for Consumable Assets
chunks.what_it_does: Enables Asset Administrators to review the details of previously recorded purchase orders for consumable assets.
chunks.why_it_matters: Provides transparency and historical data for auditing, budget reconciliation, and understanding past procurement activities for consumable supplies.
how_to_use: Navigate to the Asset Management module from the Admin Console.
Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
In the "Purchase Details" tab, click on the "View" hyperlink next to each purchase order.
examples: Reviewing the details of a purchase order from six months ago to check the quantity and cost of a specific consumable.

chunks.what_it_does: Allows Asset Administrators to allocate consumable assets to specific members or departments within the organization.
chunks.why_it_matters: Facilitates the distribution of supplies, ensures accountability for allocated items, and helps track inventory movement within the campus.
how_to_use: Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
Click the "Allotment" section.
Click "Create New Allotment" to allocate consumable assets to members or departments.
examples: Allocating 50 pens and 20 notebooks to the 'Marketing Department'.
user_questions: How do I allocate consumable assets?
Can I assign consumables to a department?
Where do I create a new allotment?
How to distribute office supplies?
What is the process for allotting assets?

chunks.what_it_does: Enables Asset Administrators to log the return of unused consumable assets from assigned members or departments back into inventory.
chunks.why_it_matters: Ensures accurate inventory counts, prevents waste, and allows for reallocation of returned items, optimizing resource utilization.
how_to_use: Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
Click the "Allotment" section.
Click the "View or Return" link next to each allotment record order to view allotments or log the return of unused consumables from assigned members or departments.
examples: A department returns 10 unused staplers from a previous allotment.

chunks.what_it_does: Allows Asset Administrators to review existing records of consumable assets that have been allotted to members or departments.
chunks.why_it_matters: Provides an overview of asset distribution, helps track who has which items, and supports auditing and reconciliation of consumable inventory.
how_to_use: Go to the "Consumable Asset" tab.
Click the "Allotment" section.
Click the "View or Return" link next to each allotment record order to view the details.
examples: Checking the allotment record for the 'Science Department' to see what lab supplies they currently have.
